sub_answers.text: The 2014 Lithuanian national final results in each show were determined by a 50/50 combination of votes from a jury panel and public televoting.[d40165141s3p0] The jury votes consisted of a combination of a Lithuanian jury panel and an international jury panel.[d40165141s3p0] From the second show to the semi-final, the Lithuanian panel was required to come to a consensus to assign one set of points that were added to the international panel results.[d40165141s3p0]

sub_answers.sub_question: What were the exact tie-break and ranking rules in the Lithuanian national selection for that year, including how ties were resolved and how acts qualified from heats to semifinals and from semifinals to the final?
sub_answers.text: Ties in the elimination shows and the semi-final were decided in favour of the entry that received the most votes from the public.[d40165141s3p0] In the final, a tie would be decided in favour of the entry awarded the most points by the jury.[d40165141s3p0] The semi-final selected only the winning song from the remaining three songs, while the final selected the winning artist-song combination from the remaining three artists.[d40165141s3p0]
